findings.title: Waterings page crashes when the list response is not an array
findings.expected: A visible error that the waterings could not be loaded, and no uncaught error
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'. The page never renders: the browser stays on the Beds content with no alert.
findings.evidence: {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]} | {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}

findings.title: Waterings page crashes on an empty-object list response
findings.expected: A visible error, and no uncaught error
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function' (twice). The page does not render and no alert is shown.
findings.evidence: {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function","waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]} | {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function","waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}

findings.title: Dashboard shows a bad recent-waterings response as 'No waterings yet'
findings.expected: A visible error that recent waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: The empty state 'No waterings yet' appears, so a failure looks like there is no data.
findings.evidence: {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds"],"pageErrors":[]} | {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds"],"pageErrors":[]}

findings.title: Dashboard renders a garbage row from a malformed recent-waterings response
findings.actual: The table shows a row reading 'Never | (blank) | –' and no alert.
findings.evidence: {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–"],"pageErrors":[]} | {"hits":1,"alerts":[],"sec":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–"],"pageErrors":[]}

findings.title: Past watering accepts tiny amounts and reports them as '0 L'
findings.expected: 0.004 L is refused (the field's min is 0.1), or it is shown as the amount actually saved
findings.actual: It is saved, the notice says 'Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026.', and the waterings list shows '0 L'.
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026."]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026."]}
